messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: CFA on binary variables
parts:
It this usual?

Yes.  Read about identification issues in depth here:

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5458787/

lavaan's default is the marginal parameterization described here:

http://dbauer.web.unc.edu/files/2014/08/kamata-bauer-2008.pdf

Also called the "delta" parameterization:

https://www.statmodel.com/download/webnotes/CatMGLong.pdf
